Figure 1: Illustrative curves showing the diminishing returns of retrieval performance (Recall@100) with increasing (a) embedding dimension and (b) number of transformer layers for an mBERT model on Bing-Click. While performance generally improves, the gains diminish significantly at higher dimensions/depths, whereas computational costs (e.g., forward latency, embedding memory) often scale linearly.
